title: Unblocked Games Vault Catalog
description: Collection of unblocked iframe games and retro arcades

games.title: Neon Snake
games.description: Guide the glowing cyber snake to collect energy orbs without crashing into walls or yourself.
games.controls: Arrow Keys or WASD to turn. Space to Pause.
games.author: Vault Arcade

games.title: 2048 Master
games.description: Join tiles with matching numbers to reach the legendary 2048 tile and rack up high scores.
games.controls: Arrow Keys or Swipe to slide tiles.
games.author: Vault Games

games.title: Galaxy Defender
games.description: Battle waves of alien starships in deep space with rapid laser cannons and energy shields.
games.controls: Left/Right or A/D to move. Space to Fire lasers.
games.author: Vault Arcade

games.title: Flappy Orbit
games.description: Flap through perilous neon pipe gates in this high-precision arcade tap challenge.
games.controls: Space, Click, or Up Arrow to jump/flap.
games.author: Vault Games

games.title: Neon Breakout
games.description: Smash every brick on the board with your high-velocity ball and precision paddle control.
games.controls: Left/Right or Mouse to move paddle.
games.author: Vault Arcade

games.title: Retro Pong Pro
games.description: Fast-paced table tennis showdown against a dynamic AI opponent with angle deflection.
games.controls: Mouse or W/S to move paddle.
games.author: Vault Games

games.title: Block Drop Classic
games.description: Arrange falling tetrominoes into complete horizontal lines to clear board real estate.
games.controls: Arrow Keys (Left/Right to move, Up to rotate, Down to soft drop, Space to hard drop).
games.author: Vault Arcade

games.title: Minesweeper Tactics
games.description: Use deductive logic to flag hidden explosive mines across the tactical grid.
games.controls: Left Click to sweep, Right Click to place flag.
games.author: Vault Games

games.title: Dino Desert Dash
games.description: Jump over spiky cacti and duck under flying pterodactyls in this infinite runner.
games.controls: Space or Up Arrow to jump, Down Arrow to duck.
games.author: Vault Games
